name: Toki no Kotoba
source:
A second-year high school girl can not speak due to mental disease. She lost all memories four years ago. This dark spot seems to have connection with distant past, story of Taisho era writer investigating his brother's death.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名高中二年级女生因心理疾病而无法说话。她失去了四年前以前的全部记忆。这段空白似乎与遥远的过去有关——大正时代，一名作家为调查哥哥之死而展开行动。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
